description: Email deliverability and spoofing-protection audit for a domain: parses SPF (mechanisms, top-level DNS lookup count, +all/~all/-all), DMARC (policy, pct, rua/ruf, alignment), probes common DKIM selectors, and reports MX, BIMI, MTA-STS and TLS-RPT. Returns prioritised findings with fix hints and a 0-100 score. DNS-based; nested SPF includes are not expanded.
name: email_auth
